text:
Marta: Quick sync — product needs a final call on the long-term multi-region / isolation approach by EOW. I sketched 3 options and a hybrid path. Need triage.
Samir: Can you paste the options? TL;DR pls.
Marta: Option A: Shared fabric + soft-residency (lowest cost, eventual residency guarantees, simple ops). Option B: Region-pinning lanes (medium cost, stronger regional SLA, moderate migration). Option C: Dedicated tenant cells (high cost, hard isolation, full residency + audit trail).
Lucy: Also call out operational burden + data migration complexity for B and C.
Ram: Customer ask from Finance vertical -> they need hard residency + audit, so leaning C for enterprise deals.
Marta: Proposed launch criteria matrix (SLOs, migration effort, unit-cost delta, sales trigger). Example snippet: 
```yaml
launch_criteria:
  slo_p95_latency_ms: 120
  migration_risk: medium
  unit_cost_multiplier: 2.5
  sales_threshold: enterprise_contract_signed
```
Samir: Missing cache/KV semantics row — how does each option affect prefix/KV cache hit rates?
Lucy: Good point. Also we need fallback behavior if a region is degraded. Suggest a policy DSL sample for fallbacks: 
```policy
- when: region_unavailable
  action: route_to_global_pool
  degrade: true
  max_tokens: 5000
```
Nora: Operational note — we don't have enough capacity to spin dedicated cells in Q2. Hybrid approach: default to B with 'eviction leash' and paid SLA for regulated customers might be viable.
Ram: Hybrid seems like the pragmatic compromise. Who are the pilot customers?
Marta: Pilot plan: 2 enterprise customers (audit/regulatory needs) + 3 mid-market opt-ins. Migration phases: opt-in -> shadow routing -> incremental cutover -> post-cutover retros.
Samir: Monitoring/metrics we need: error-budget burn, p95/p99 tail latency, cross-region egress cost, migration error rate, billing delta per_100k_tokens.
Lucy: Console req: per-route telemetry for policy hits, percent routed to fallback, and trace IDs surfaced to SRE.
Nora: I'll scope gating: acceptance tests + canary rollback hooks + KMS audit verification for Private customers.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: policy-dsl-v2 -> staging (PR #4567) :rocket:
Samir: :eyes: Can we get a back-of-envelope cost for 'soft-residency' at 10k paying customers?
Marta: Samir — I'll pull an incremental cost model from finance; expect rough numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Ram: Product wants a decision by Friday. Team vote: A/B/C/hybrid?
Lucy: Vote = hybrid (region-pinning lanes + eviction leash).
Samir: Vote = hybrid.
Nora: Vote = C for regulated customers, hybrid generally.
Marta: Consensus looks like hybrid. I'll draft the PRD, rollout checklist, and a migration playbook with explicit canary gates. Thanks everyone :heart:
